## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and worked as a schoolteacher after graduating. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was completing her second term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Stella wrote to her and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) to suggest they rent a house together in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) for the upcoming school year alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). The plan came to fruition when the girls secured Patty's Place, where Stella moved in for their sophomore year and began keeping household expenses with the others. During their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Stella joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room one rainy evening to listen to melodramatic stories [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had written in her younger days. As their four years at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) came to a close, Stella and her housemates completed their final examinations and packed up their belongings to leave Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P9](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Quotes

> "And now, Anne, I’ve a little plan. You know how I loathe boarding. I’ve boarded for four years and I’m so tired of it. I don’t feel like enduring three years more of it."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Friend P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> "As to the financial part—but I’ll not begin on that. Those whom the gods wish to destroy they first make country schoolmarms!"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Friend P10](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0010)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formed a close friendship during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Stella later wrote to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) during their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), proposing that they rent Patty's Place together in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) along with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as chaperone. They live together during their sophomore year and final year, sharing household duties and enjoying evenings together where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her old stories.

- Friend of — intimate academy friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +1 more</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) were former school chums at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) who maintained a close bond into their college years. Stella reached out to [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to organize a joint living arrangement in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) for their second year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Together with their housemates, they manage household expenses and live comfortably at Patty's Place.

- Friend of — former school chums at Queen's Academy (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) share a close relationship as frequent correspondents who keep in touch by mail. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes letters to Stella sharing lighthearted anecdotes and humorous updates about her life and work in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Friend of — correspondent and close friend (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P18](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0018)</sub>
